article.story: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. -- — Jah'likai King scored 21 points to help UMBC defeat Binghamton 78-60 on Monday. King shot 8 for 15 for the Retrievers (10-7, 3-1 America East Conference). Caden Diggs scored 14 points while going 6 of 11. Anthony Valentine went 6 of 8 from the field to finish with 13 points. The Bearcats (4-16, 0-5) were led by Wes Peterson and Zyier Beverly, who each scored 18 points. Jackson Benigni had 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
